purpose: Pre-register comparable pilot ablations for continuing a bilingual 8K encoder; this file is a plan, not a training record.

pretraining_source.source: Hugging Face dataset repository wikimedia/wikipedia, pinned to the verified immutable dataset revision.
pretraining_source.metadata_verification_scope: Repository revision, zh/en config names, file counts, and dataset-card license metadata were checked via the repository/API only. Dataset files were not downloaded and row schemas were not inspected.
pretraining_source.availability_rule: Before any data collection, verify the pinned repository revision, both exact config names, and applicable dataset-card license/attribution terms. If a config is absent or terms are unsuitable, stop and version a replacement plan; do not silently change revision or config.
pretraining_source.normalization: After inspecting the pinned row schema, map only article text and title fields; version and record the loader, field mapping, and normalization code. No row schema has been inspected yet.

deduplication.exact: SHA-256 of normalized full text, within language.
deduplication.near_duplicate: Version-pinned same-language MinHash over normalized 5-grams; Jaccard threshold 0.90; retain the lexicographically smallest document ID per group.

split.algorithm: integer(SHA-256(language_code || stable_upstream_record_id)) mod 100; if no stable ID is exposed, use the normalized document SHA-256 as the ID and record that fallback.

pretraining_source.evaluation_contamination_audit: Before sampling, exclude mapped benchmark page IDs and exact normalized benchmark query/context strings; report unresolved title or near-duplicate overlap without using benchmark test content for training or selection.

tokenizer.counting_rule: Count non-padding content tokens; exclude padding, BOS/EOS/SEP, MASK, and other tokenizer-defined special tokens.

exposure_budget.sampling: Select separately within each language from the train partition ordered by SHA-256(language_code || document_id || sampling_seed); stop at the exact content-token target and record any final-document truncation.

evaluation_sources.split_rule: Official train for fine-tuning, validation/dev for selection, test for final evaluation only.
Use only official train/validation/test splits where provided; freeze the task configuration and exact asset revision.
Freeze task IDs and official corpus/query qrels revisions; never use test queries or qrels for training, hard-negative mining, or checkpoint selection.

shared_training.optimizer_and_schedule: Choose once on the common baseline, record exact values and software versions before ablations, then hold fixed; no per-arm hyperparameter tuning.
shared_training.kernel_dtype_batch: Record and hold constant within each comparison; compare architectures with the same attention implementation.

stage_1.shared_by: all arms in objective and retrieval comparisons

stage_2_span_objective.treatment: contiguous-span MLM at the same 30% target-token rate

stage_2_retrieval_objective.shared_stage_1: The same 80M-token MLM prefix and resulting checkpoint in both arms.
stage_2_retrieval_objective.control: Continue MLM; average the losses from two independently corrupted views of each sentence.
stage_2_retrieval_objective.treatment: SimCSE-style contrastive loss from two independent dropout views of the same sentence; negatives come only from other training sentences in the current batch.
stage_2_retrieval_objective.compute_budget: Each final stage receives exactly the measured FLOPs of the two-view MLM control on the same 20M unique source content tokens; stop at that budget and record actual token exposure.

compute_accounting.equal_token_view: Every arm consumes the stated content-token target; separately report cumulative train FLOPs and wall time.
compute_accounting.equal_flops_view: Profile the baseline with a fixed counting method and hardware/software stack; set the cumulative FLOPs cap before running variants; stop every arm at that same cap and report actual token exposure.

ablations.primary_quality_metric: Equal-weight mean of zh/en span F1 across held-out 8K evidence conditions and evidence positions.

ablations.purpose: Extraction boundary quality and task retention
ablations.control: Dynamic token MLM in the final 20M-token stage.
ablations.treatment: Contiguous-span MLM in the final 20M-token stage.
ablations.primary_quality_metric: Equal-weight mean of zh/en span F1 on official extraction test splits.

ablations.purpose: Bilingual bi-encoder retrieval quality under a fixed training-compute budget
ablations.control: Two-view MLM in the final stage.
ablations.treatment: SimCSE contrastive loss in the final stage.
ablations.primary_quality_metric: Equal-weight mean of zh/en nDCG@10 on frozen retrieval test tasks.
ablations.branch_compute_budget: FLOPs of the reference 20M-token MLM stage

evaluation_protocol.baseline: Original pinned mmBERT-base checkpoint with the same task heads and downstream fine-tuning recipe.
evaluation_protocol.ablation_effect_reference: Each treatment is compared with its matched control at the same token exposure or FLOPs budget as defined for that ablation.
evaluation_protocol.retention_reference: The original pinned mmBERT-base checkpoint, evaluated with the same task heads, fine-tuning data, recipe, and seeds.

baselines.name: sliding_512
baselines.aggregation: maximum answer or relevance score across chunks

evaluation_protocol.uncertainty: Use 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples of frozen test examples, stratified by task and language; also report each of the three seed scores and their standard deviation. The bootstrap interval describes paired test-sample uncertainty; three seeds do not establish broad training-run uncertainty.

quality_path.primary_metric_rule: Pre-register one primary metric per ablation; express metrics on a 0-100 point scale, average equally over Chinese and English, and macro-average the prespecified test strata for long-evidence evaluation.
quality_path.target_gain_reference: Matched control for the same ablation.

structural_cost_path.quality_reference: Every-third-layer-global attention baseline under the same training view.

execution_status.note: The local package contains CPU plumbing checks only; this proposed protocol requires a separate approved compute and dataset run.
